editors/vscode.reason: Transitive dev dependency of @vscode/vsce (via @azure/identity), used only by vsce's interactive 'publish' auth flow. CI only ever runs 'vsce package', never 'vsce publish' -- Marketplace publishing stays manual by design, so this code path is never exercised. No stable @azure/identity release fixes this yet as of the review date (4.15.0 exists only as a beta); remove this entry once one ships and the lockfile is updated.
